scope: Analysis recipients only. Tsukuroi retains OS diagnosis; no row authorizes mutation or secret reads.

routes.trigger: A reported local endpoint or served-model identity symptom needs serving-layer diagnosis.
routes.retains: Kernel, GPU driver, package and systemd unit diagnosis.
minimum_evidence: UTC capture window
reported endpoint symptom without credentials
driver and unit probe commands, exit codes and observations
unverified serving-layer question
routes.counterexample: A stale DKMS registration alone remains OS diagnosis; do not infer an endpoint incident from GPU state.
routes.forbidden_inference: A successful nvidia-smi query proves endpoint readiness or served-model identity.

routes.trigger: A credential-bearing helper's mode, ownership or package finding raises an auth-flow or credential-hygiene question.
routes.retains: Package provenance, version and filesystem metadata diagnosis.
minimum_evidence: UTC capture window
path, numeric mode, uid and gid
package owner/version command, exit code and observation
auth-safety question marked unknown; no secret values or vault references
routes.counterexample: An unrelated non-credential package checksum drift remains package diagnosis, not a kagi incident.
routes.forbidden_inference: Package ownership or setgid mode alone establishes exposure or auth safety.

routes.trigger: A reported desktop rendering, binding, menu or idle symptom requires configuration or visible-surface diagnosis.
routes.retains: OS package, GPU driver and user-manager/unit health.
minimum_evidence: UTC symptom time
observed visible symptom
relevant OS probe command, exit code and observation
configuration surface named without copying its contents
routes.counterexample: A failed user unit without a configuration or UI question remains OS diagnosis.
routes.forbidden_inference: An active user unit proves that the visible UI works.

routes.trigger: A host pressure observation or kill signal needs fleet/wave liveness, progress or event correlation.
routes.retains: OS memory, journal, boot and systemd diagnosis.
minimum_evidence: UTC capture window and boot or explicit event-window limitation
exact counter or PSI command, exit code and observation
distinguish class presence, cumulative count and dated event
correlation question without causal attribution
routes.counterexample: A driver/boot repair question without fleet attribution remains tsukuroi even when mori reads the same journal.
routes.forbidden_inference: A cumulative memory.events count dates a new kill or identifies a responsible wave.

routes.trigger: A reported task/hub dispatch, routing or orchestration-semantics defect is distinct from host liveness.
minimum_evidence: UTC symptom time
minimal reported dispatch symptom
non-sensitive task/wave identity if available
OS probe command, exit code and observation; exclude raw arguments and environment
routes.counterexample: A lane silence or wave-settlement question without a dispatch-mechanism defect goes to mori.
routes.forbidden_inference: A live unit or process proves correct dispatch semantics.

routes.trigger: An authorized driver, firmware or package question requires shipped-artifact internals rather than health inventory.
routes.retains: Loaded version, package provenance and driver/boot diagnosis.
routes.ownership: unresolved: kaidoku and revenger both declare shipped-artifact reverse engineering; this row requests arbitration, not target execution
minimum_evidence: UTC capture time
exact internals question
authorized artifact identity/path and digest when safely obtainable
relevant OS probe command, exit code and observation; no raw core or invocation
routes.counterexample: An unowned module file or loaded-driver-version mismatch alone remains tsukuroi; no RE analysis is authorized.
routes.forbidden_inference: Overlapping declarations let tsukuroi select an RE owner or execute an artifact.

routes.trigger: A reproducible census blind spot raises a reusable verification or mutation-testing method question.
routes.retains: Census implementation, domain contract, repair and lane-local verdict ownership.
minimum_evidence: UTC capture time
minimal failing command, exit code and observed behavior
measured census revision
expected domain invariant and bounded method question
routes.counterexample: A package repair or ordinary census implementation bug without a reusable-method question remains tsukuroi.
routes.forbidden_inference: One lane's case proves a general verification pattern or transfers census code ownership.

lifecycle.prepared: Sanitized packet exists; no delivery or acceptance implied.
lifecycle.reported: Packet is cited in the lane's committed fleet report for the named recipient/integrator.
lifecycle.acknowledged: Named recipient has supplied a durable receipt.
lifecycle.accepted: Named recipient has explicitly accepted the analysis question with durable evidence.
lifecycle.resolved: Recipient-side closure evidence answers the question; acknowledgement alone is insufficient.

mixed_question_rule: Split OS diagnosis from the requested sibling analysis. Unmatched or disputed questions go to the protocol integrator; no first-responder ownership.
verification_status: Source-anchored contract; parent smoke and read-only packet receipt are recorded in the companion Markdown note. No recipient acceptance claimed.
